description: The JSON ABI of one BlazePhoenix contract, generated from the Solidity sources, with the source revision it was built from. Use it to encode your own calls to the addresses get_deployments returns, or pass `errors` to decode a revert reason from a failed swap or quote. Returns { contract, revision, abi }; an unknown name returns ok:false with the accepted list. Pure lookup, no RPC.

contract.description: quoter (quotes and previews) | router (swap entry point) | solver | hub | core | errors (the protocol custom-error set, for decoding reverts)

name: get_abi
title: Contract ABI
